# key: # Preferred vowel quantities where the lexicon's headword differs from the reader tradition (Orberg, OLD).

note: nārrō (long a, as in nārrat of the readers)
thēa (long e, as the readers write it)
accusative plural omnēs, as the readers write it (the lexicon lists omnīs)
accusative trēs, as the readers write it (the lexicon lists trīs)
dative / ablative plural eīs, as the readers write it (the lexicon lists iīs first)
